data.homeNewsDetails: Ullmark will start vs. Philadelphia on Thursday.
data.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Ottawa's previous game raised concerns when Ullmark exited in the second intermission with an undisclosed injury. Still, he fully participated in the team's morning skate on Thursday and will return to the crease against the Philadelphia Flyers. The 33-year-old Swedish goalie had an up-and-down 2025-26 season, but has started 2026-27 on a positive note, with an impressive 1.20 GAA and .949 SV% in two outings (2-0-0). The Senators enter Thursday's contest as -175 home favourites against a Flyers team that has been outscored 17-5 through four games (0-2-2).
data.awayNewsDetails: Woll will start in Ottawa on Thursday.
data.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Joseph Woll has clearly outplayed Dan Vladar as the 2026-27 season begins and could earn more playing time if he keeps impressing. The 28-year-old Woll has saved 78 of 84 shots (.929 SV%) in two games this season, going 0-0-2 for a Flyers team that has been offensively miserable, scoring only five combined goals in four games (0-2-2). The Flyers enter Thursday's contest as +155 road underdogs against a 2-1-0 Ottawa Senators team.

data.homeNewsDetails: Swayman will start vs. Utah on Thursday.
data.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Jeremy Swayman had a miserable 2024-25 season after signing a massive eight-year contract extension, posting an ugly 3.11 GAA and .892 SV% in 58 games (22-29-7). The organization had concerns about the contract, but he followed it up with a solid 2025-26 season, posting a 2.71 GAA and .907 SV% in 55 games (31-18-4). Now, the 27-year-old goalie seems to be continuing his upward trajectory, opening the season with a 2.30 GAA and .914 SV% in three games (2-1-0). That said, he is coming off his weakest performance of the season, allowing four goals on 24 shots (.833 SV%) in a 4-1 loss to the Ottawa Senators. Swayman hopes to rebound Thursday, as the Bruins enter as slight +112 home underdogs against the Utah Mammoth, who have outscored opponents 17-8 over four games (3-1-0).
data.awayNewsDetails: Cossa was the first goalie off the ice at Utah’s morning skate.
data.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Karel Vejmelka carried a heavy workload last season for Utah, and with rookie Sebastian Cossa as his backup for 2026-27, it was unclear how the crease would be split. That said, after a strong debut, saving 18 of 19 shots (.947 SV%) in a 4-1 win over the Columbus Blue Jackets, the 23-year-old Cossa will return to the crease on Thursday for his second start in five games. The Mammoth enter Thursday as -121 road favourites against a Boston Bruins team that has scored only nine goals in four games (2-2-0).

data.homeNewsDetails: Kochetkov is in the starter's crease for Thursday morning's skate.
data.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Hurricanes' Head Coach Rod Brind'Amour started Brandon Bussi in the first two games of the season, but he seems to be easing into an even goalie rotation, with Kochetkov tending the twine on Thursday in his second start of the season. The 27-year-old Kochetkov missed most of the 2025-26 season with a lower-body injury, but he played well in his return to action, saving 16 of 18 shots (.889 SV%) in a 3-2 win over the Philadelphia Flyers. The Hurricanes enter Thursday's contest as enormous -337 home favourites against the surprisingly potent early-season offense of the Vancouver Canucks, who have scored 19 goals in their first four games (2-2-0).
data.awayNewsDetails: Lankinen was the first goalie off the ice at Vancouver's morning skate.
data.awayNewsFantasyDetails: Vancouver's stoutest defensive outing of the season came with Leevi Merilainen between the pipes in a 4-1 win over the Calgary Flames. Still, the Canucks will turn to Lankinen on Thursday for his fourth start in five games. The 31-year-old Lankinen is coming off his best outing of the season, but he still struggled, allowing three goals on 28 shots (.893 SV%) in a 3-2 loss to the Vegas Golden Knights. Lankinen has an ugly 6.50 GAA and .824 SV% in three games (1-2-0). The Canucks enter Thursday's contest as significant +290 road underdogs against a 2-1-1 Carolina Hurricanes team.

data.homeNewsDetails: Luukkonen is in the starter's crease for Thursday's morning skate.
data.homeNewsFantasyDetails: Still without Alex Lyon (upper body), the Sabres will keep leaning on Luukkonen, turning to him for the third time in four games. That said, Luukkonen's de facto starting netminder role hasn't translated into success. The 27-year-old Finnish goalie has allowed eight goals on 37 shots (.784 SV%) in two outings, but has salvaged a 1-1-0 record. The Sabres enter Thursday's contest as slight +105 home underdogs against a Dallas Stars team coming off a one-sided 5-0 victory over the San Jose Sharks.
data.awayNewsDetails: Oettinger will start in Buffalo on Thursday.
data.awayNewsFantasyDetails: After a miserable start to the season, outscoring 6-1 in their first two games (0-2-0), the Stars are coming off a 5-0 statement win over the San Jose Sharks and hope to carry that momentum into Thursday's contest against the Buffalo Sabres. The 27-year-old Oettinger stopped all 13 shots for his first shutout of the season, improving to a 1.01 GAA and .943 SV% in two games (1-1-0). The Stars enter Thursday's contest as slight -114 road favourites against a 2-1-0 Buffalo Sabres team.
